evidence.result: hb-shape JSON for 'a -> b != c' with JetBrains Mono Bold: 11 glyphs, clusters 0-10 in order, advances 600; ligature glyphs hyphen_greater.liga (cluster 3) and exclam_equal.liga (cluster 8); ID and name outputs match expected JSON; repeat runs byte-identical; hb-view SVG 666x158.72, 11 use elements, sha256 ff74b181 repeated; contact sheet shows both ligatures unclipped.
evidence.scope: Fixed string with two ligatures, one OFL font, hb-shape JSON and hb-view SVG repeat output; HarfBuzz 15.1.0 on macOS arm64. Not kerning, other fonts, scripts, subset or formats.

summary: Text shaping engine with native libraries and utilities such as hb-shape and hb-view; turns text plus a font into positioned glyph output and supports subset operations.
use_when: When you need script-aware shaping diagnostics
When comparing glyph positioning across fonts or shaping settings
avoid_when: For font editing, subsetting and instancing: fonttools
For final scene text rendering: browser or renderer
